items.q: How do I test my schema after pasting it?
items.a: Use Google's Rich Results Test or the Schema Markup Validator with your page address, and fix any errors it reports.

items.q: Which schema type should I use?
items.a: Use FAQ for question pages, Local Business for a shop or office, Article for blog posts, Product for items, Course for programs and Breadcrumb for navigation.

items.q: Is the schema markup generator free?
items.a: Yes. The schema markup generator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.a: Yes. Schema and technical SEO are part of our SEO team's work, and our website team sets it up at build time.
